description: This file defines the VideoDecoderCache class, which manages a cache of video decoder information for Android media codecs. It includes nested class CachedDecoder, methods for cache refresh, expiration check, and retrieval of decoders based on MIME type.

classes.name: VideoDecoderCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of video decoder capabilities, providing thread-safe access and refresh mechanisms.

classes.name: VideoDecoderCache.CachedDecoder
classes.description: Represents cached information about a specific video decoder, including capabilities and supported ranges.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cache has expired based on TTL override.

methods.name: refreshDecoders
methods.description: Refreshes the cache with current decoder info from MediaCodecList.

methods.name: getCachedDecoders
methods.description: Returns a list of decoders capable of decoding the specified MIME type, refreshing cache if expired.
